changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: idx_agent_job_review_work is invalid after an interrupted build. Run DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_agent_job_review_work, then start again.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid WHERE c.relname = 'idx_agent_job_review_work' AND NOT i.indisvalid

changeSet.comment: Index the reviews of one piece of work, so the admin review list counts a review's place on its work without reading every job's metadata. Built concurrently, so writes to agent_job go on while it builds.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_agent_job_review_work ON agent_job ( workspace_id, purpose, job_type, (CASE job_type WHEN 'PULL_REQUEST_REVIEW' THEN metadata ->> 'pull_request_id' WHEN 'ISSUE_REVIEW' THEN metadata ->> 'issue_id' WHEN 'CONVERSATION_REVIEW' THEN metadata ->> 'slack_thread_id' WHEN 'DOCUMENT_REVIEW' THEN metadata ->> 'docs_document_id' END), created_at, id)

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_agent_job_review_work
